title: Qt: Have the main application forward the InterfaceListChanged signal
description:
The InterfaceListManager is a child of the MainWindow class.
Many QObjects created as children and grandchildren of the
WiresharkMainWindow and StratosharkMainWindow want notification
about interface list changes from the InterfaceListManager.

Even though they're created in the correct order so that the
InterfaceListManager already exists, mainapp->mainWindow()
returns nullptr during the constructors because it's not shown
yet. (This has to do with its origin in getting the parent window
for SimpleDialog, as it's better for various reasons to pass a
nullptr to a QDialog parent than a non-visible parent.
Cf. f86f54eb9070effb6216861749523d3a32932d47)

We could wait until appInitialized to make the connection, but there's a
flaw - there's a synchronous interface query before appInitialized, and
many of these windows want to know about it. Right now they get an
unconditional signal that the interface list has been updated at the
same time as the app is initialized. OTOH, if a capture file is read from
the command line, or prefs.capture_no_interface_load is set, then the
synchronous interface query is skipped, and these probably should *not*
get that signal - particularly for the InterfaceFrame, which will
start the stats, which we don't want to do if interfaces aren't loaded
at all due to those options. (On Windows in particular this can be
both slow and cause an unwanted UAC prompt.)

For now, route through the MainApplication, so that the
interfaceListChanged signal is forwarded from the InterfaceListManager
(the single source of such information) to all the consumers, because
we know that won't return nullptr (even though it makes sense to
have the central hub be the MainWindow, mainapp->mainWindow()
returns nullptr and we don't have a way of searching for it at the
moment.)

Ping #21318

notes.body: enabled automatic add to merge train when checks pass

changes_data.diff:
@@ -190,14 +190,6 @@ private:
     QMap<int, QString> ifTypeDescription;
 
 private slots:
-    /**
-     * @brief Subscribes to the window's InterfaceListManager::interfaceListChanged.
-     *
-     * Deferred until appInitialized when the frame is built before the window's
-     * manager exists; the manager is reached via mainApp->mainWindow().
-     */
-    void connectInterfaceListManager();
-
     /**
      * @brief Slot triggered when the selection in the interface tree changes.
      * @param selected The newly selected items.

@@ -342,6 +342,17 @@ public:
     /**
      * @brief Retrieves the main window instance.
      * @return Pointer to the MainWindow.
+     *
+     * @note This returns nullptr if the MainWindow is not visible, which is
+     * useful for (not) parenting SimpleDialogs that might appear very early,
+     * because a QDialog with a hidden parent can have odd geometry or taskbar
+     * behavior. OTOH, that's not very useful for connecting signals and slots
+     * of the (Wireshark|Stratoshark)MainWindow and its children, grandchildren,
+     * etc. with one another. (Particularly during the constructors, when the
+     * MainWindow is not visible yet, but is when it makes sense to connect
+     * signals.) We end up going through the MainApplication for some signals,
+     * but it could make sense to have an option to return the main window even
+     * if it's visible.
      */
     MainWindow *mainWindow();
 
@@ -456,6 +467,12 @@ protected:
 signals:
     /** @brief Signal emitted when application is fully initialized. */
     void appInitialized();
+    /** @brief Signal emitted when interface list changes (forwarded from
+     * the MainWindow's InterfaceListManager, which is the one true source
+     * of interface list changes, but mainWindow() returns nullptr during
+     * the constructors where siblings and relatives want to connect to
+     * the InterfaceListManager. */
+    void interfaceListChanged();
     /** @brief Signal emitted for local interface events (add/remove/up/down). */
     void localInterfaceEvent(const char *ifname, int added, int up);
     /** @brief Signal emitted to open a specific capture file. */
